variants.headline: Looking back: home world sends punitive expedition
variants.sub: A punitive expedition has been dispatched by the home world.
variants.body:
We return to {first_reported}. Our report recorded this: The home world had sent a punitive expedition.

Dispatch of an expedition is not a complete account of conditions in the colony. Commercial readers should resist translating it automatically into a forecast of interruptions or losses. A careful judgment separates the known political action from assumptions about timing, physical effects and the terms of any eventual encounter.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

We defend {target} against a verdict based on imagined events. The expedition's dispatch is serious news, but a fair assessment must not convert every feared consequence into an accusation already proven.
